resourceProfile.assessment: The complete English and European Portuguese source scope, review metadata, glossary, and project concept references were available locally.

automatedQuality.summary: Translation review metadata, queue validation, typecheck, 79 test files with 462 tests, complete build, 39 IIS rules with 61 route cases, and 724 generated-link checks passed.

linguisticCritique.summary: A bounded European Portuguese pass identified 25 actionable terminology, grammar, formula-notation, circuit, thermal, and heat-flux defects; all 25 were corrected.

competentHumanReview.summary: No competent European Portuguese human review was performed in this cycle; changed IDs remain machine-drafted.

publicationAuthorization.summary: No merge, publication, deployment, or residual-risk authorization was requested or granted.

findings.summary: The zero-resistance warning used an incorrect unit-first phrase.
evidence: The previous text was Uma resistência nula Ω é um curto-circuito ideal.
findings.resolution: Changed it to a resistance of 0 Ω and clarified the separate treatment.

findings.summary: The current example title used the adjective atual instead of the technical noun corrente.
evidence: The previous title was Encontrar atual.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Calcular a corrente.

findings.summary: The resistance example title used an inconsistent imperative form.
evidence: The previous title was Encontre resistência.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Calcular a resistência.

findings.summary: The voltage example title used an inconsistent infinitive phrase.
evidence: The previous title was Encontrar tensão.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Calcular a tensão.

findings.summary: The Joule-heating paragraph called electrical energy a rate and described it as changing temperature.
evidence: The previous paragraph began A energia elétrica é uma taxa de transferência de energia.
findings.resolution: Corrected the subject to electrical power and clarified the role of heat-flux density.

findings.summary: The safety paragraph translated safety margin as space.
evidence: The previous paragraph used Utilize o espaço adequado.
findings.resolution: Changed it to maintain an adequate margin.

findings.summary: The Kirchhoff description omitted the specific conservation principles.
evidence: The previous description referred generally to conservação em nós de circuito.
findings.resolution: Named charge conservation at nodes and energy conservation around closed loops.

findings.summary: The circuit-terms introduction used the literal phrase mais fácil de raciocinar.
evidence: The previous text said tornam um diagrama de circuito mais fácil de raciocinar.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it as making a circuit diagram easier to interpret.

findings.summary: The KVL formula translated the protected parallel-branch note.
evidence: The previous expression ended with (ramos paralelos).
findings.resolution: Restored the protected expression ending (parallel branches).

findings.summary: The KVL explanation used the English loanword loop.
evidence: The previous paragraph instructed the reader to choose uma direção de loop.
findings.resolution: Used the standard Portuguese term direção para a malha.

findings.summary: The series-cell statement used an awkward phrase for ampere-hour capacity.
evidence: The previous sentence said a capacidade em amperes-hora permanece a de uma célula igual.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it using capacidade em ampere-hora and an equivalent individual cell.

findings.summary: The parallel-cell statement did not clearly express approximate proportional addition.
evidence: The previous sentence ended with aumentam aproximadamente.
findings.resolution: Clarified that capacity and available current increase approximately proportionally.

findings.summary: The resistor-equation bullet used the literal phrase fazer corresponder.
evidence: The previous bullet began Faça corresponder a tensão e a corrente do resistor.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it as relating resistor voltage and current through V = I × R.

findings.summary: The TCR display name used an unnatural Portuguese construction.
evidence: The previous name was Coeficiente de resistência à temperatura (TCR).
findings.resolution: Changed it to Coeficiente de temperatura da resistência (TCR).

findings.summary: The linear-model heading contained an unnecessary article.
evidence: The previous heading was O modelo linear.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the concise technical heading Modelo linear.

findings.summary: The TCR units omitted conventional spacing around division.
evidence: The previous bullet used 1/°C or ppm/°C.
findings.resolution: Normalized the units to 1 / °C and ppm / °C.

findings.summary: The right-triangle explanation used literal and imprecise descriptions of the sides.
evidence: The previous paragraph used o lado oposto está oposto a este and touches it wording.
findings.resolution: Rewrote the definitions of opposite, adjacent, and hypotenuse with the SOH-CAH-TOA ratios.

findings.summary: The degree-to-radian formula omitted spacing around division.
evidence: The previous expression used θ_deg × π/180.
findings.resolution: Changed it to θ_deg × π / 180.

findings.summary: The heat-capacity display name used capacity of heat rather than the standard technical term.
evidence: The previous name was Capacidade de calor.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Capacidade térmica.

findings.summary: The basic-relationships heading used a literal cognate instead of relações.
evidence: The previous heading was Relacionamentos básicos.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Relações básicas.

findings.summary: The heat-flux description omitted the density/per-area meaning.
evidence: The previous description began O fluxo de calor descreve.
findings.resolution: Changed it to densidade do fluxo de calor and explicitly stated each unit of area.

findings.summary: The heat-flux summary did not state the per-area quantity directly.
evidence: The previous summary said transferência através de uma unidade de área.
findings.resolution: Changed it to taxa de transferência por unidade de área.

findings.summary: The worked-example title called heat flux caudal, which means volumetric flow rate.
evidence: The previous title was Caudal médio do aquecedor.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Densidade média do fluxo de calor.

findings.summary: The heat-flux conclusion omitted the density term and thousands separator.
evidence: The previous conclusion used O fluxo de calor médio é de 5000 W/m².
findings.resolution: Changed it to heat-flux density of 5.000 W/m² and retained the W/cm² conversion.

findings.summary: The AWG area formula used a corrupted variable name and spacing.
evidence: The previous expression used UMA = π × d ^ 2/4.
findings.resolution: Restored the protected area formula A = π × d^2 / 4.
